what: THE TIER-1 SELF-LAND ROUTE IS UNCONFIRMED, and the one PR that could have settled it today was destroyed as evidence by the manager. #12744 was Tier-1, `landing: "self"`, automerge armed, merge slot claimed, mergeable_state clean with green CI at 13:47Z and still unmerged at 13:55Z. The E42 lane flagged it and DELIBERATELY did not hand-merge, reasoning that establishing whether the route is broken is worth more than the merge. The manager then hand-merged it at 14:15:55Z during a queue sweep without reading that reasoning, and the merge API returned a success response rather than the 405 an already-merged PR returns. A later lane report concluded the route 'landed on its own' and is therefore fine; that is NOT established, and it is the dangerous direction to be wrong in. WHY THE OBVIOUS CHECK CANNOT ANSWER IT: `merged_by` reads `benbaichmankass` whether the automerge relay or a session merged, so the actor field cannot distinguish them. WHAT IS ESTABLISHED: the DELAY has a mundane explanation — a merge commit pushed at ~13:50Z restarted CI and the route correctly waits for green on the current head. That explains the wait; it does not show the route would have fired. WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND ONE PR: if the route is broken, every Tier-1 PR in this repo is quietly routing through a human — which is the exact failure .github/pr-landing/README.md records (seven green PRs sitting unmerged on 2026-09-03) and says it was built to end. It would be invisible in any view that only counts merged PRs.  ===== UPDATE 2026-09-22T15:40Z ===== RESOLVED, AND THE ANSWER IS BETTER THAN EITHER STORY I HAD. The open question was whether the Tier-1 self-land route is broken, after #12744 sat green and armed for eight minutes and the manager then hand-merged it, destroying the observation. The E28 lane hit the same wall from the other side and named the cause; confirmed at the primary source: `.github/workflows/claude-pr-automerge.yml` fires on `push: branches: ["claude/**"]`. EVERY E42 BRANCH WAS `lane/e42-*`, NOT `claude/*` — lane/e42-guard-first, lane/e42-shared-symbol-resolver, lane/e42-mode-writer-comment, lane/e42-roster-symbol-union. So the relay never fired for #12744 and COULD NOT HAVE, whatever its checks or arming file said. [!] WHICH MEANS THE ROUTE IS NOT BROKEN AND MY HAND-MERGE DESTROYED NOTHING — the outcome was already determined by the branch name before any of us looked. The E42 lane's instinct to preserve the observation was right; the observation just did not exist. Both halves of my earlier account were wrong: not 'the route is broken', and not 'it was about to fire'. [!] THE REAL DEFECT IS IN THE DISPATCH, AND IT IS MINE. The `claude/` prefix is LOAD-BEARING for self-landing and my dispatch template does not say so, so a lane that picks any other prefix is silently unable to self-land — it looks armed, the request file is present, the slot is claimed, and nothing fires. E28 hit it too and had to enable auto-merge by hand. Successor row: PI-20260922-JN54P2HH-0003.
